Canavan seeks Capricornia seat, clashes with Hanson on climate

Senator Matt Canavan is seeking pre-selection to run for the lower house seat of Capricornia in the upcoming election. This move potentially sets up a significant contest with One Nation, with Canavan reportedly calling out One Nation leader Pauline Hanson on climate change.
